senses.gloss:
ITA-9.7.16 śaṅkāviṣam शङ्काविषम्
Doubt about being poisoned
The fear or suspicion of being poisoned or bitten by a poisonous animal or snake may develop into symptoms which resemble those of being poisoned when no poison is involved.

ITA-7.2.8.3 śaṃkhaḥ शंखः
Conch shell
Calcium carbonate (CaCO3). Duly processed shankha is employed as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.

ITA-3.2.4 śaṅkhaḥ शङ्खः 
Temple
One of the ten sites in the body where vital life force is predominantly located.

ITA-5.67.11 śaṅkhakaḥ शङ्खकः
Severe pain at temporal region

ITA-3.13.46 śaṃkhāvartasandhiḥ शंखावर्तसन्धिः
Convoluted shell-like joint

ITA-9.2.40 saṅkarasvedaḥ सङ्करस्वेदः
Sweating induced by medicated bolus
A type of sudation therapy in which diaphoresis is achieved by external application of prewarmed medicine in bolus form, with or without a covering cloth.

ITA-1.9.3.3.12 saṅkalpaḥ सङ्कल्पः
Evaluation
The process of assessing merits and demerits.

ITA-9.5.53 saṅkṣipta सङ्क्षिप्ः
Lobuloplasty type 11
A type of lobuloplasty indicated when the pinna is atrophied, and one flap of the divided ear lobule is absent and the other one very small.

ITA-1.9.4.4.4 saṃkhyā संख्या
Number, enumeration, tally
The quality that enables determination of amounts and calculations.

ITA-4.5.18 saṅkhyāsamprāptiḥ सङ्ख्यासम्प्राप्तिः
Number of subtypes of pathogenesis
Number of pathogenesis subtypes characteristic of a disease or condition.

ITA-4.8.6 saṅgaḥ सङ्गः
Body channel dysfunction involving obstruction
Obstruction of the body channels with restriction of movement; sometimes resulting in the formation of a collateral pathway.

ITA-4.2.22 samghātabalapravṛttarogaḥ संघातबलप्रवृत्तरोगः
Traumatic physical injury
Diseases and conditions caused by trauma and injuries.
